notes.title: The Devil's Shoes will release on August 16th!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of you out there!

As work on Yomi Alliance's newest update continues, today it's with great joy that I'm announcing you the release of my newest full videogame: The Devil's Shoes.

Some of you might already be aware of it since it was present on itch.io and Patreon for a while, albeit in a pre-release status with 3 episodes out of 6. This game will release in its full state now, as all of the 6 initial episodes are available right now for you to enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40950240/a9ebf28b111d0d07c3d5b7fa090c39ccee1e6b70.png

In The Devil's Shoes you'll play different, non related episodes featuring... welll... sex! This game is an adult Visual Novel with lots of different endings (all of which is tied to an achievement) and new CGIs to look at. From a masseuse table to a foursome, up to cheating with your dream girl, you will get many opportunities with the game.

New episodes will be released as DLCs as well, but the game is already complete as it is, for an enjoyable and replayable experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40950240/f7aab947b5c8d6640b298e4a57b0b3430a1861a6.png

Take on the Devil's shoes, its amazing soundtrack, its funny script and its beautiful characters and fulfill your kinkiest desires.

Thank you for following my games, and supporting my work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40950240/6166f075b4d1b4e4dee8c6a35b5bee181cd3b0f3.png

ANDREA
